rounds.prompt: How much did the heaviest pumpkin ever grown weigh?
How many people holding hands would it take to circle the outside of Stonehenge's ring of giant standing stones?
rounds.source: English Heritage: Stonehenge's sarsen circle is 30 m across. 1.5 m of line per person hand to hand is our estimate

rounds.prompt: The London Eye opened to the public in 2000. Counting only its public opening hours, how many full turns has it made since then?
rounds.source: London Eye's 7,668 turns a year (ITV, Time Out) over 25.8 open years since March 2000
